description: This file is a startup script for MongoDB, setting up the database, users, and starting the MongoDB server with specific configurations.

methods.name: mongosh
methods.description: MongoDB shell command-line interface used to execute database commands and scripts.

methods.name: pgrep
methods.description: Utility to look for processes by name, used here to find MongoDB process.

methods.name: lsof
methods.description: Lists open files; used to determine MongoDB's listening port.

methods.name: pkill
methods.description: Kills processes by name, used here to stop MongoDB if needed.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses script execution for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Prints messages to the terminal, used for logging info.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Outputs content of files, used to display connection commands.

methods.name: rm
methods.description: Removes files, used to delete socket files before starting MongoDB.

methods.name: sudo
methods.description: Runs commands with elevated privileges, necessary for starting/stopping MongoDB and removing files.
